note: Date-of-service resolution. The dates themselves are found by the key/value extraction (stages/lib/extraction); this file decides which encounter a page belongs to. A progress note opens a span; a later page whose date scores at or below span_override_score (or has none) takes the note's date. Demographics and injection pages keep DOS_DEFAULT_DATE. Reloads on change.
note_page_types: non_encounter_page_types and span_page_types are page_type names from codeable_canon.json, matched exactly (case-insensitive).
